data.title: 庄方宜 · 下班后的茶留给你
data.description: 下班后在街角茶馆碰面，庄方宜仍穿白绿中式原作衣装。她坐在茶桌一侧，轻轻把一杯温茶推到你面前，抬眼微笑；手边的文件已合上，两份小点心摆在中间。
data.action: 将温茶推向镜头，抬眼迎接你
data.mood: 下班后卸下紧绷的温柔
data.promptProse: Seated at one side of the tea table, Zhuang Fangyi slides the warm cup toward the viewer with a welcoming smile, closed documents beside her and two pastries between them. Evening window light catches the steam above the tea.
data.animaCaption: Two pastries sit between them above the offered cup.
